newsitem.title: USA: Long-term forecast cold for the central U.S.
newsitem.headline: Long-term forecast cold for the central U.S.

text.p: It may be after Christmas before the central U.S. warms up from frigid weather that sent sub-zero temperatures deep into Kansas and zero to single digit readings through the Texas Panhandle, forecasters said.
The current system produced severe blizzard conditions in the north central states and pushed average temperatures 15 to 20 degrees below normal from the Dakotas to Texas.
Thursday morning may be the coldest, with lows 10 degrees below zero Fahrenheit or more from the Dakotas to Nebraska, said Fred Gesser, president of Weather Express Inc.
